title: X.509 policy-tree safe-core: reconnaissance + ownership/invariant freeze
objective: Freeze the ownership model and the invariants the X.509 policy-tree conversion must conserve, and decompose the conversion into independently recoverable units (649 interior ops; FFI_EXPORT 11, RAW_POINTER_DEREFERENCE 246, UNSAFE_FUNCTION_CALL 268, UNSAFE_METHOD_CALL 124).

ownership_model.representation: raw heap blocks; no arena, no Vec
ownership_model.level_array: CRYPTO_calloc pcy_tree.rs:265, reached by pointer arithmetic (level.add/sub)
ownership_model.known_gap: ossl_policy_cache_free (pcy_cache.rs:419-429) is #[allow(dead_code)] with no caller; the per-cert policy_cache leaks on X509_free. Recorded, not to be silently fixed.

invariants: public C ABI: 11 exported symbols' names/signatures unchanged (x509_vfy.h.in:800-823)
return word: FAILURE=-2 INVALID=-1 INTERNAL=0 VALID=1 EMPTY=2 EXPLICIT=4; *ptree/*pexplicit_policy set only on VALID

pointer identity + stable address: get0 accessors are borrowed, valid until X509_policy_tree_free; parent/node/policy pointers must be the identical graph objects; levels array and nodes must not move after linking
traversal ordering: node stacks sorted by OBJ_cmp(valid_policy); anyPolicy is index 0; authority set in level/parent order, user set in policy_oids order
allocator contract: graph built via OPENSSL_malloc/zalloc/calloc/free (CRYPTO_*), sizes observable through CRYPTO_set_mem_functions; failure returns NULL -> INTERNAL
error/raise semantics: pcy_tree raises nothing; ERR_raise sites stay in pcy_cache/pcy_data/pcy_node
cleanup: X509_policy_tree_free free set exact; SHARED_QUALIFIERS frees shared qualifiers once; cert refs released via X509_free
CVE-2023-0464 cap: node_maximum=1000; exceeding -> add_node NULL -> INTERNAL
cert refcounts: level.cert holds a counted ref (X509_up_ref pcy_tree.rs:312)

baseline.existing_court: courts/phase11/rt_x509_verify_probe.c policy_surface (736-878): drives X509_policy_check return word + tree shape
baseline.null_arm_court: courts/phase10/rt_store_probe.c (1070-1079): nine accessors NULL arms only

next_action: Start P25-X509-002: choose the stable-address representation (keep CRYPTO_* blocks or prove allocator conservation by differential) and build the minimal x509-policy differential harness (courts/phase25 + forensics/tools), running it green on the UNCONVERTED crate as the parity baseline.
stop_condition: P25-X509-002 stops when the differential harness runs green against the unmodified crate (baseline parity) and records the exact graph block sizes and CRYPTO_*/sk_* call counts; the existing phase10/phase11 courts stay green.
